buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for equilibration and incubation.

salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the isotherm experiment.

process_id_elab.description: Process identifier as stored in eLabFTW metadata.

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition.

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used in each well.

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand/protein.

pump_duration_s.description: Duration for which the pump is running during loading/equilibration.

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for binding equilibrium to be reached.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles used prior to loading.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations for the loading isotherm.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution.

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of ligand concentrations (e.g. uM, mg/mL).

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution.

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used.

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used.

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis run reported by the analysis script.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database.

summary.description: High-level metrics aggregated from analysis results.

files_processed.description: Number of raw data files processed by the analysis script.

n_replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition (if available).

data_files.description: Output data files generated by the analysis script.

plots.description: Plot files generated by the analysis script.

warnings.description: Warnings reported by the analysis script.

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis JSON loaded from analysis_results_*.json.
